missions.title: Establish the Social Graph
missions.description: Trace the connections between Dr. Maya Rao and all lab personnel using Breadth-First Search (BFS).

missions.title: Examine Suspect Profiles
missions.description: Use the Hash Table Detective Database to query suspect usernames and locate high-risk individuals.

missions.title: Reconstruct the Incident Sequence
missions.description: Traverse the Case Timeline forward and backward using the Doubly Linked List.

missions.title: Inspect the Evidence Chain
missions.description: Follow the linear Singly Linked List clue chain from the initial darkweb dispatch to the final payout.

missions.title: Prioritize Strongest Forensics
missions.description: Extract the highest-credibility forensic items from the Max-Heap priority queue.

missions.title: Perform Structural Tree Traversals
missions.description: Run Preorder (Top-down) and Postorder (Bottom-up) traversals across the case hierarchy tree.

missions.title: Execute Sorted BST Retrieval
missions.description: Run Inorder traversal on the Evidence Binary Search Tree to produce a sorted list of all evidence IDs.

missions.title: Submit Final Accusation
missions.description: Identify the primary culprit, verify their motive, method, and opportunity, and close Case 001.

hints.text: Look at Dr. Maya Rao's direct connections in the social network graph. The perpetrator had direct knowledge of her lab schedule.
Check the Timeline around 19:40-19:50. A suspect's library alibi is contradicted by CCTV Camera 04 at the rear fire stairs.
Use the Hash Table database to search '@ryan_47' and inspect Evidence #1061 and Evidence #1160. Notice the SSH reverse tunnel and USB mass storage exfiltration.

achievements.title: First Clue
achievements.description: Discovered and analyzed your first evidence item.

achievements.title: Network Analyst

achievements.title: Deep Dive

achievements.title: Hash Hunter
achievements.description: Performed 3 or more O(1) searches in the Detective Database.

achievements.title: Backtracker
achievements.description: Utilized Stack Backtracking to return to a previous investigation state.

achievements.title: Queue Master
achievements.description: Processed evidence items through the FIFO evidence pipeline.

achievements.title: Timeline Detective

achievements.title: Tree Walker

achievements.title: Algorithm Master
achievements.description: Successfully demonstrated all 12 custom data structures and algorithms.

achievements.title: Case Closed
achievements.description: Accused the correct culprit with supporting forensic evidence.
